mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Fireman's Park. Tonight features a first quarter moon and a brief space station flyover starting at 10:04 PM, moving from Middleton near Verona High School toward Fitchburg. Overnight, we will see temperatures drop to 59 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins September 23 affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing multiple development projects on October 5.
You can catch live music at Bailey's Run today, or head out to the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli tomorrow.
On September 5, a driver was arrested for an O W I offence after being stopped for speeding on the highway.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so we do not have a flavor of the day to report at this time.
